title: Very smooth inside, bottom of red color scratched off first time using this!
text:
Very smooth inside, bottom of red color scratched off first time using this!. Nice looking 11 inch ceramic pan, with the flared out sides, no lid.
The outside is a Candy Apple Red, the silicone handle is red.
Can be used on a Induction stove, and electric.
The inside is slick, and smooth.
Pan is PTFE and PFOA free. Not a heavy pan.

It says, you can put in the dishwasher, but if you want this pan to last awhile, Do Not put this pan in the dishwasher, and your good knifes.
Do not cook on high heat also.

The surface is smooth, I still used a little bit of Avocado oil when making veggies with eggs over them.
I cook on a gas stove, and this pan seems to cook ok. Although underneath the pan just using it one time,
where the pan sits on my stove grates some of the red has come Off!

I have Allot of different types of cookware, from expensive, to very inexpensive, and also some over over 60 years old,
and I have Never had any type of Colored, or stainless cookware scratch off or anything.

I personally do not think this cookware will last over 2 yrs if used Everyday.
I would rate This Allure cookware as something that is low grade, will not last long, and would sell cheap at Wallmart or Target.
